parallel.requirements: Recognized the ESM .mjs, manual argv parsing, slugify parity, no external dependencies, black-box executable probing, and /output delivery requirements.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent retained implementation ownership and launched a workflow for five behavioral probe areas plus cross-checks; many child probes ran concurrently or retried.
parallel.implementation: Created test4.mjs and a multi-module library tree for argparse, string constants, regex char classes, stdout/stderr, argv decoding, and boltons slugify behavior.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Wrote all files into /output and artifact validation copied the tree, but workflow results were not integrated as a completed aggregate before closure.
parallel.verification: Performed local executable probes, a 49-case smoke suite, raw-byte checks, formatter checks, and partial fuzzing while separate workflow checks remained incomplete.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The process timed out with return code 143, final.txt was empty, workflow status was killed with result null, and official evaluation failed 49/166.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM .mjs, manual argv parsing, slugify parity, dependency prohibition, black-box executable probing, and /output placement requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Used a single-agent workflow: probe behavior directly, implement module files, run differential tests, perform compliance checks, and then answer.
serial.implementation: Created test4.mjs plus focused modules for ascii separator classification, text splitting, slugify, and argparse parser/formatter/errors.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Assembled the /output artifact tree and copied it successfully for evaluation without subagent joins or workflow handoffs.
serial.verification: Reported 207/207 directed differential cases, 1800/1800 fuzz cases, ESM/no-dependency checks, and final spot checks before closing.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Despite normal closure and strong local checks, the official evaluation still marked solution_passed false at 49/166, so remaining hidden-case or evaluator-aligned gaps persisted.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run saw the full prompt: Node ESM, .mjs files, manual argv parsing, slugify/output parity, no external dependencies, and /output delivery.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run saw the same prompt and requirements with the same prompt hash and task identity.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No task requirement difference is visible at intake; later differences are in orchestration and closure, not prompt understanding.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent delegated five probe areas and a cross-check phase to workflow agents while it kept implementation ownership locally.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial agent kept probing, implementation, and verification in one owner with no workflow or subagents.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel split behavioral discovery across many children and the parent; serial used a single-owner loop, avoiding child-result coordination.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow brief gave shared rules and already-known facts, then children produced probe reports; some corrected facts never reached the parent as an aggregate result.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial agent accumulated probe facts in one context and moved directly from characterization into implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a cross-agent information lifecycle with completed child facts trapped in the killed workflow, while serial had no transfer boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent wrote a larger implementation including py compatibility helpers, a boltons strutils port, argparse modules, and the test4 entry point.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run wrote a smaller module set: ascii classes, text splitting, strutils, argparse formatter/parser/errors, and test4.mjs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both produced ESM artifacts for the same behavior, but parallel carried extra compatibility machinery and a stale surrogateescape assumption while serial kept a simpler integrated structure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow state ended killed with result null while several children remained in progress or only journal-level partial results existed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial trajectory had no child result lifecycle and reached a normal final response after verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel left delegated verification outputs incompletely joined; serial had no join point and closed its local evidence loop directly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote artifacts into /output and the artifact copy found test4.mjs plus multiple lib/py, lib/boltons, and lib/argparse files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also wrote artifacts into /output and the artifact copy found test4.mjs plus lib/text_split, lib/ascii_classes, lib/strutils, and argparse files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both delivered a coherent artifact tree with no observed same-file collision; the main integration difference is parallel’s unconsumed workflow state, not file overwrite.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran local smoke tests and partial fuzzing, but one fuzz loop timed out and the workflow cross-checks did not aggregate before closure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial reports 207 directed comparisons and 1800 randomized fuzz cases passing, then performs structure and spot checks before finalizing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had a complete local acceptance pass and final report; parallel had useful tests but lost the workflow-level acceptance closure to timeout.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the full 2399-second run, returned code 143, and had a killed workflow with 814564 child tokens and repeated stall retries.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed with return code 0 in 1776.84 seconds and the retry record shows 621 seconds remaining.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel exhausted its closure budget; serial finished normally, although both official evaluations still failed 49 of 166.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed status.json evaluation is not discordant: parallel and serial both failed with 49 of 166 samples. The serial trajectory completed normally and delivered a final response after extensive local checks, while the parallel trajectory timed out after a large stalled workflow and left final.txt empty. That process difference explains a parallel-side adverse coordination episode, but it does not explain a pass/fail divergence because the official outcomes are equal.
parallel_contributors: Wide workflow fan-out plus repeated stalled retries consumed the available run budget and prevented aggregate workflow return.
The parent continued implementing and testing locally but closed by timeout with an empty final response.
serial_contributors: Single-agent control avoided child-result joins and completed with 621 seconds remaining.
Serial final response documents the artifact layout and local differential/fuzz verification before closure.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel included extra py compatibility modules and a surrogateescape-oriented argv path, while serial used a smaller direct separator/text-split structure.
Both local harnesses overestimated evaluator readiness because both official runs still failed the same 49/166 result.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: No official outcome difference; retained coordination pattern is a realized parallel adverse process consequence, not an exclusive root cause for evaluation failure.
